adoptionRecord.scope: ar-veterans-court-set only; bounded pre-adjudication held-form implementation and conditional supported handoffs

ownerDirection.ownerStatement: ADOPT THE BOUNDED TREATMENT, SUBJECT TO THESE REVISIONS.
ownerDirection.authorityBoundary: The record identifies the direction as owner product design and expressly says it is not a new counsel opinion.

verifiedRules: Repealed §16-101-106 and old §16-98-303 are not treated as current authority.
The July 27, 2021 ACIC petition/order binaries and printed citations remain unchanged, with current-law reconciliation delegated to governed instructions and source receipt.

preAdjudicationBoundary.verifiedRule: The held pair is limited to deferred proceedings without an entered judgment of guilt followed by successful veterans-treatment-court completion; unsupported post-adjudication cases stop the generated-form branch and receive a supported handoff without a substantive-relief denial.

verifiedRules: Successful specialty-court completion and prosecuting-attorney recommendation are required inputs.
The judge owns criminal-history consideration and appropriateness; findings, recommendation, approval, and related facts are never prechecked, prefilled, attested, or manufactured.

crossCourtRelief.verifiedRule: The §16-90-1602(d) branch is conditional and same-level: a circuit specialty judge may address another circuit conviction and a district specialty judge another district conviction only with successful completion, completed other-court sentence, other-court agreement, and other-court signature on the ACIC uniform order. Obsolete checkboxes and generic concurrence do not substitute; court-owned fields remain blank until supplied by the proper actor.

timingPriorFeloniesAndDwiBwi.verifiedRule: Immediate entry after successful completion is permissive rather than guaranteed; the ordinary §16-90-1406(c)(1) numerical prior-felony limit is excluded without removing other requirements; DWI/BWI remains blocked until the applicable §5-65-111 lookback.

verifiedRules: Serve the county prosecuting attorney and the arresting agency only when it is a named party, within three days after filing.
The prosecuting attorney has 30 days after receipt or filing, whichever is later, to oppose.

The participant does not handle post-order agency distribution; the clerk sends statutory certified-order distribution and the old form's inconsistent recipients/timing are reconciled in instructions while its printed text remains evidence.
The uniform sealing-petition filing fee is $0 under §16-90-1419.
No fee-waiver application is generated solely for this no-fee petition.
Program, treatment, testing, supervision, public-defender and other charges, plus fines, restitution, court costs, and other-case obligations, remain separate from the filing fee.
Stage 1 is distinct from post-completion sealing and uses current Arkansas Judiciary Veterans Treatment Court criteria rather than the ACIC petition alone.

Available records must support adult participant status, criminal charge/case, veteran or qualifying service-member status, qualifying mental-health or substance-use disorder, clinical/risk assessment treatment, team admission/approval, and successful completion.
Clinical findings, risk classifications, team approval, and completion are never manufactured; Stage 2 starts only when necessary completion facts are supported.
The two held ACIC source hashes are bound and unchanged; stale citations do not trigger reacquisition or source-byte edits.

Participant fields are collected-fact fields only. Prosecutor, court, judge, recommendation, approval, signature, finding, and order-entry fields remain protected until supplied by the appropriate actor.

acceptanceControls.verifiedRule: The record requires bounded implementation, saved-byte/component/branch checks, independent semantic review, frozen current packet bytes, current-byte raster and original-page review, native integration, and preservation checks; it grants no packet PASS, raster PASS, counsel approval, terminal promotion, or production authority.

priorLegalResolutionCopies.meaning: Historical 2026-09-11 legal resolution remains preserved; the AR owner record is an additive scoped record.

Packet implementation, semantic review, source/completeness checks, current-byte raster/original-page review, native integration, and terminal admission remain separate gates; the historical draft remains NOT_ADOPTED and no packet, counsel, raster, terminal, route, or production authority is granted.
